description: Generic MCP harness config for b1e55ed gateway — works with any MCP-compatible client (not DeerFlow-specific).

b1e55ed.description: b1e55ed signal intelligence gateway. Accepts JSON-RPC tool calls over HTTP.
notes: Set B1E55ED_API_KEY to your assigned API key (see gateway/config.yaml).
Role determines which tools are accessible: analyst < pm < risk < admin.
submit_research_signal from non-admin roles is queued for admin approval.
Audit log written to gateway/data/audit.jsonl on every request.

tool_call.description: Example JSON-RPC call — get current regime status.
